summary.text: Keith Harris is a Democrat who was elected in 2024 to represent Pennsylvania's 195th Legislative District in the state House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Before his election, Harris served on the board of Strawberry Mansion Health Center from 1993 to 1999 and became an honorary board member of the Strawberry Mansion Learning Center in 2008. From 2014 through 2023 his involvement with the Cecil B. Moore Recreation Center helped drive community projects and address food insecurity.

He earned a certificate in liberal arts through the Act Now program at Philadelphia Community College from 1980 to 1982, and from 1984 to 1990 worked in Philadelphia's graffiti removal program under the late Tim Spencer.
His stated priorities as a state representative include mental health advocacy, education, fair employment opportunities and the effective distribution of public-safety resources.
